jobs.description: About Toptal Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce. We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Position Description: As SVP, Product, you will shape the vision as to where Toptal’s products and platforms go next and then drive the execution to build them. This is the most senior product role in the company. You will report to the Chief Executive Officer, sit on the executive team, and work collaboratively with our Engineering, Design, Finance, Marketing, New Businesses, Professional Services, and Customer leaders. AI is not a line item on your roadmap. It is the roadmap. You should be Toptal’s foremost expert on what AI means for products and platforms. That means real depth in fine-tuning and post-training, agent design and evaluation, and the economics of running models in production, along with the judgment to know which applies to us. Work directly with our AI researchers rather than through them. We expect both the AI agenda and the product strategy to originate with you. We will react to your plan rather than hand you ours. This is a hands-on role. You will write your own specs and pull your own data. When you think an agent could take over a piece of work, you will build a rough version and find out whether it holds up before anyone budgets for it. You will sit in product reviews and say what you actually think. We move fast, and we need Product setting the pace. You will own and set the standards for the hiring bar for the product team, bringing in talent that will advance Toptal to the next level. Your remit runs across the business: the core platform, the talent and client experiences, the internal systems that run it, the products we take to market, and the data and AI platform underneath them. You will work hand in hand with Engineering on the platform all of it runs on, fold acquisitions and new products into the portfolio, and know growth marketing cold, because how a product reaches the market is part of building it. Product is yours to shape at blazing speed: scoping, sizing the teams, planning headcount, and defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing them off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about landing an A player and treats an open seat as urgent. Your own dedication and hard work will set the tone, and the people you bring in should be inspired to do the best work of their careers on this team. We are looking for the person who will define what an AI-native product organization looks like and then run it successfully. This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. Responsibilities: The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. AI and agentic product • Own Toptal’s AI product strategy: where agents and models belong across the marketplace, the talent and client experiences, our internal systems, and the products we take to market, along with the business outcomes they carry. • Decide what we build with AI and what we do not, including build-versus-buy on models and tooling and the packaging and pricing of AI-enabled products. • Make AI quality measurable through evals, acceptance bars, and review loops, and partner with Engineering on the platform as its most demanding customer. • Rebuild how Product works using AI, raising the output

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager - Precision Medicine
jobs.description: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. Role Overview The Product Manager – Precision Medicine is responsible for defining, prioritizing, and delivering product capabilities that enable scalable precision medicine workflows across clinical, laboratory, and data ecosystems. This role partners closely with engineering, clinical, operations, data, commercial, and external laboratory partners to translate customer needs and business objectives into a clear product strategy, roadmap, and prioritized backlog. The Product Manager will own product initiatives across areas such as molecular testing workflows, laboratory integrations, electronic ordering and results, structured molecular data, interoperability, clinical decision support, and longitudinal patient insights. This role requires strong product judgment, technical fluency, customer empathy, and the ability to navigate complex healthcare workflows and stakeholder environments. The Product Manager is expected to operate with a high degree of independence, balance strategic priorities with execution realities, and ensure product investments deliver measurable customer and business value. Key Responsibilities Product Strategy & Roadmap • Develop and maintain product strategy and roadmap priorities for Precision Medicine capabilities aligned with broader organizational and platform objectives. • Translate customer, clinical, operational, and business needs into clearly defined product opportunities and outcomes. • Evaluate competing priorities using customer value, clinical utility, strategic alignment, business impact, technical feasibility, and implementation complexity. • Define clear product goals, success measures, and expected outcomes for roadmap initiatives. • Communicate product direction, trade-offs, dependencies, and priorities effectively to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. • Partner with product leadership to identify opportunities to expand and mature Precision Medicine capabilities over time. Product Discovery & Customer Insights • Engage with clinicians, customers, operational teams, laboratory partners, and internal stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, and unmet needs. • Lead product discovery activities to validate problems and evaluate potential solutions before committing significant engineering investment. • Translate customer feedback, product telemetry, operational data, market trends, and stakeholder input into actionable product insights. • Develop a deep understanding of molecular testing workflows, including test selection, ordering, specimen workflows, result delivery, interpretation, and downstream clinical use. • Balance individual customer or partner requests against scalable product capabilities that can support broader market needs. Product Requirements & Delivery • Translate product strategy and customer needs into clear capabilities, requirements, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria. • Own prioritization of the product backlog in partnership with engineering and other product team members. • Partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to evaluate solution options, technical dependencies, sequencing, and trade-offs. • Ensure initiatives are sufficiently defined and understood before entering development. • Participate actively in backlog refinement, sprint planning, demonstrations, release planning, and other Agile delivery processes.
